title: Name & Address of Manufacturer / Packer / Importer
description: Every package must bear the complete postal address and identity of manufacturer or packer.

title: Generic / Common Name of Commodity
description: The common or generic name of commodity contained in the package must be prominently declared.

title: Net Quantity & Standard Units
description: Net quantity in standard SI units (kg, g, L, ml, N). Symbols like 'gm', 'gms', 'ltr' are prohibited.

title: Month & Year of Manufacture / Packing
description: Clear declaration of month and year of manufacture or pre-packing.

title: Maximum Retail Price (MRP)
description: Must be declared in format '₹ XX.XX (incl. of all taxes)' or 'MRP Rs. XX.XX incl. of all taxes'. Dual MRP is illegal.

title: Unit Sale Price (USP)
description: Mandatory declaration of price per unit (per g/kg/ml/L/number) for consumer comparison.

title: Numeral & Letter Font Height on PDP
description: Minimum numeral height determined by Principal Display Panel (PDP) area (1.0mm to 4.0mm).
